description: Action-level AUC of every method on the two query folds, for three ways of measuring the distance between motions. "cluster_tier" asks whether a target clip of the right action group ranks above clips of other groups; "test_test" keeps only the queries whose two skeletons were both held out of training. Each interval is written [lower, point estimate, upper]. "per_cluster_test_test_cluster_tier" splits the held-out queries by action group.
